name: Barbituric acid
summary: Barbituric acid or malonylurea or 6-hydroxyuracil is an organic compound based on a pyrimidine heterocyclic skeleton. It is an odorless powder soluble in water. Barbituric acid is the parent compound of barbiturate drugs, although barbituric acid itself is not pharmacologically active. The compound was first synthesised by Adolf von Baeyer.

uses.text: Alkylation of barbituric acid can form a large variety of barbiturate drugs that behave as central nervous system depressants. As of 2007, more than 2550 barbiturates and related compounds have been synthesised by this and other routes, with 50 to 55 in clinical use around the world at present. The first to be used in medicine was barbital (Veronal) starting in 1903, and the second, phenobarbital was first marketed in 1912.

summaryZh: 巴比妥酸是一種有機化合物，化學式為C4H4N2O3，它由德國化學家阿道夫·馮·拜爾在1864年研究尿酸時發現。巴比妥酸的德語名稱「Barbitursäure」衍生自拜爾的愛人芭芭拉。
summaryZhHans: 巴比妥酸是一种有机化合物，化学式为C4H4N2O3，它由德国化学家阿道夫·冯·拜尔在1864年研究尿酸时发现。巴比妥酸的德语名称“Barbitursäure”衍生自拜尔的爱人芭芭拉。

pharmacology.en: It is the parent ring of the barbiturates but is not itself active in the brain, because it is too water loving to cross into it. The active drugs are made by adding carbon side chains at one position of the ring.
pharmacology.zh: 它是巴比妥類藥物的母環，但本身在大腦中沒有活性，因為它太親水而無法進入腦內。有活性的藥物是在環上某個位置加入碳側鏈後製成的。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是巴比妥类药物的母环，但本身在大脑中没有活性，因为它太亲水而无法进入脑内。有活性的药物是在环上某个位置加入碳侧链后制成的。

sideEffects.en: As a laboratory chemical rather than a drug, its effects in people are not described. It is an irritant to skin, eyes and airways, as laboratory powders of this kind usually are.
sideEffects.zh: 作為實驗室化學品而非藥物，它對人體的作用沒有相關描述。和這類實驗室粉末一樣，它會刺激皮膚、眼睛與呼吸道。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为实验室化学品而非药物，它对人体的作用没有相关描述。和这类实验室粉末一样，它会刺激皮肤、眼睛与呼吸道。

fact.en: Barbituric acid itself has no effect on the brain. Only when carbon chains are hung on its central carbon does it become a sedative, and over two and a half thousand such compounds have been made.
fact.zh: 巴比妥酸本身對大腦沒有作用。只有在它的中心碳上接上碳鏈後才會變成鎮靜劑，至今已有兩千五百多種這類化合物被合成出來。
fact.zhHans: 巴比妥酸本身对大脑没有作用。只有在它的中心碳上接上碳链后才会变成镇静剂，至今已有两千五百多种这类化合物被合成出来。
